nodes.label: NestJS backend (api, worker, voice)
nodes.rationale: Owner directive; modular-monolith layout maps 1:1 to product domains and mature guards/pipes/interceptors carry authz, validation and rate limiting. Hono was the research's original pick and was overridden.

nodes.label: ts-rest contract layer + Zod 3.25 pin
nodes.rationale: The one Nest-native contract-first option giving both end-to-end typed clients and emitted OpenAPI 3.1; Zod stays pinned at 3.25.x because ts-rest Zod-4 support is still an RC.

nodes.label: Drizzle ORM + append-only migrations
nodes.rationale: SQL-first: Postgres RLS via SET LOCAL is natural, emitted SQL is inspectable by agents, and drizzle-zod bridges tables into the Zod contract schemas.

nodes.label: Fly postgres-flex 3-node cluster (deprecation risk accepted)
nodes.rationale: Fly-native-only directive plus Fly MPG having no bom region; Fly has DEPRECATED unmanaged Postgres, so 3-node repmgr HA, two backup layers and restore drills are mandatory mitigations, with logical replication as a documented escape hatch.

nodes.label: BullMQ + Upstash Redis fixed plan
nodes.rationale: Fly explicitly recommends fixed plans for BullMQ because PAYG per-request billing is inflated by polling; eviction must stay OFF because Upstash eviction silently breaks queues.

nodes.label: PowerSync self-hosted (Open Edition)
nodes.rationale: The decisive property is that the write path is our own NestJS connector, while PowerSync supplies the genuinely hard parts — durable local SQLite, upload queue, checkpoint consistency and the attachment state machine.

nodes.label: Better Auth self-hosted (organization + phoneNumber + jwt)
nodes.rationale: Phone PII never leaves India because it is a TS library on our own DB rather than a US SaaS; Clerk was rejected on DPDP liability and cost.

nodes.label: Bare React Native (no Expo, iOS + Android)
nodes.rationale: Owner directive excludes Expo, which removes EAS Build and makes the macOS iOS CI lane mandatory; the studio opens as an authenticated WebView rather than being rebuilt as a native canvas.

nodes.label: three.js + WebGPURenderer with WebGL2 fallback
nodes.rationale: WebGPU is baseline across browsers in 2026 and the swap is near one line with automatic fallback; TSL compute shaders power the GPU shadow-map shading path.

nodes.label: Lingui v5 (one catalog, Next.js + bare RN)
nodes.rationale: The only compile-based option covering both surfaces from one catalog; Paraglide has no first-class RN support, which was the dealbreaker.

nodes.label: Exotel telephony + Sarvam AI speech/LLM
nodes.rationale: Strongest India carrier compliance and in-country audio/PII; Sarvam has the lowest WER in 13/15 Indian languages. Spike S5 corrected the plan: BYO is inbound forwarding only, AgentStream provides no DTMF-send, and the 1600-series is closed to non-BFSI.

nodes.label: Razorpay Subscriptions + Invoices
nodes.rationale: One India-licensed PA covering mandates, trials and invoices, and the cheapest recurring rail; Stripe still is not a general domestic India acquirer in 2026.

nodes.label: Playwright headless Chromium PDF rendering
nodes.rationale: Chromium's HarfBuzz is the only path that shapes Devanagari correctly; react-pdf is disqualified on long-standing broken conjuncts and matras.

nodes.label: Biome + dependency-cruiser + sherif + Turborepo Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Style/correctness, semantic layers, versions and physical encapsulation are enforced together without dragging an ESLint runtime back in.

nodes.label: Exact Version Pin Policy
nodes.rationale: pnpm save-prefix='' means exact versions everywhere and the lockfile is the single authority; sherif fails CI on cross-package drift so there is one version of everything.
